name: SV Dugout Pulse
description: Live stats, performance grades, and alerts for pro, NCAA, and summer-ball players we represent or follow. Python scrapers rebuild a static dashboard every 15 minutes during game hours and post milestone alerts to Slack.
users: All agents (dashboard + #dugout-pulse alerts + Monday/monthly recap emails); Kent for summer-ball placements + the daily MiLB watch
hosting: GitHub Pages (static site, rebuilt by scheduled GitHub Actions workflows; repo is public)
access: Dashboard is public (unauthenticated GitHub Pages). Repo + Actions require Stadium-Ventures org membership.

links.note: Check the 'Last updated' stamp first when something looks stale.

links.note: All scheduled jobs run here. Stale data? Look for red (failed) or grey (cancelled — usually a timeout) runs, then re-run via workflow_dispatch.

inputs: Master roster + recruits Google Sheets (published CSVs — ROSTER_URL / RECRUITS_URL secrets)
MLB Stats API (pro), NCAA school-site scraper waterfall (D1Baseball → ESPN → NCAA.com → Sidearm → StatBroadcast → stats.ncaa.org)
Baseball-Reference Register (summer-ball stats; next-day lag is normal)
Kent's summer placement sheet — transcribed by hand into data/summer_ball_placements.json in the repo (source of truth for summer assignments)
MLB Stats API roster entries (person endpoint, rosterEntries hydration) — used by the MiLB watch to drop absence findings for players who are on the IL or rehabbing
outputs: Static dashboard + player pages on GitHub Pages
Live milestone/performance alerts + daily summer recap → #dugout-pulse (SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL)
Summer placement-conflict review pings + quiet-streak alerts (client hasn't played in 8+ days) → #dugout-pulse (for Kent)

Daily MiLB watch (8:30 AM ET) → #dugout-pulse (SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL): for every client at an affiliated level (CPX/A/A+/AA/AAA), recent form (trailing 14d and 30d) graded against that player's own season line with the compared window removed, plus a usage read (playing time cut 40%+ over the last 14 days vs the 16 before it). Posts lull, usage-down, no-games-and-not-IL, and trending-up findings so front-office / farm-director calls get scheduled off data. A rolling board, not an alert stream: every category shows every morning it qualifies and drops off the morning it doesn't — no cooldown, nothing suppressed for having been posted before. Silent when nothing qualifies. Message format is locked and pinned by a byte-for-byte test (BE, 2026-08-14). Full tracking snapshot (every MiLB client, alerting or not) in data/milb_watch.json.
Monday hitter recap + monthly recap emails via Resend (recipients hardcoded in scripts/monday_email.py / monthly_email.py)
Health findings only → #sv-automation via SV_AUTOMATION_WEBHOOK_URL: pipeline failure alerts, daily freshness check, roster-regression alerts, LLM health-monitor digest (silent when healthy)
GitHub issues labelled 'pulse-health' opened by the LLM health monitor, each with a paste-ready Claude Code fix prompt

Roster-move fast path: on ANY detected team change (promotion, MLB call-up, option, demotion, or lateral affiliate move) fires a GitHub repository_dispatch — event_type "dugout-pulse-roster-move" — at Stadium-Ventures/sv-registry, so the registry reconciles the move within ~1 minute instead of waiting for its hourly tripwire. Fire-and-forget: a failed dispatch never blocks the Slack post, and sv-registry's hourly cron remains the fallback. Auth: SV_REGISTRY_DISPATCH_TOKEN (fine-grained PAT, contents r/w on sv-registry only).

crons.what: Main pulse — live stats every 15 min during game hours (10 AM–2:45 AM ET)
Historical aggregation (6 AM ET), yesterday rotation (4:15 AM ET), overnight backfills (3 + 5 AM ET)
Baseball-Reference summer stats refresh (9 AM / 12 PM / 5 PM ET)
Summer roster refresh + regression & quiet-streak alerts (4×/day)
MiLB watch — form + usage vs. season baseline → #dugout-pulse, silent when nothing is actionable (8:30 AM ET)
crons.note: Must run after the 11:00 UTC historical pass in pulse.yml — that pass rebuilds the window_*.json files this reads.

crons.what: LLM health monitor → #sv-automation (9 AM + 7 PM ET)
Daily self-health-check — data-freshness audit → #sv-automation, silent when healthy (6 PM ET)

crons.schedule: Mon 7:30 AM ET / 1st of month — external cron-job.org fires workflow_dispatch

monitoring: All health findings go to #sv-automation, silent when healthy. Four layers: (1) daily self-health-check at 6 PM ET verifies freshness of every scheduled data product (live pulse, BBRef stats, summer rosters) — catches silent cron skips AND timeout-cancelled runs that never trigger failure alerts; (2) per-run failure alert steps on the main pulse workflow and on MiLB Watch; (3) rule-based summer alerts (roster-count regression; client quiet streaks post to #dugout-pulse as feature output since 2026-07-28); (4) an LLM health monitor twice daily that reads the health envelope, #dugout-pulse colleague comments, and CI runs, opens 'pulse-health' GitHub issues, and posts a digest only when actionable. Every post follows the SV message contract (product label, 🛠️/👤 tag, what broke / how we know / what to do).
knownIssues: Summer Ball Roster Refresh workflow has been hitting its 15-min timeout and getting CANCELLED on every scheduled run since ~2026-07-20 (roster snapshot stale since 2026-07-16). Cancelled runs don't trigger failure alerts — the new daily health check now flags the staleness, but the refresh itself needs a 🛠️ fix (speed it up or raise timeout-minutes). 👤 Mike DeCicco

GitHub Actions cron occasionally skips runs silently — the email digests already moved to cron-job.org triggers; a cron-job.org backup trigger for the BBRef refresh is planned but not wired. 👤 Mike DeCicco

NCAA/summer scrapes depend on a rotating proxy pool (SB_PROXY_URL + SB_HTTP_PROXY, _2, _3 secrets) to get past Cloudflare/Incapsula — proxy exhaustion shows up as 403s and blocked-client alerts. 👤 Mike DeCicco
HS_STATS_URL is referenced in a workflow but not set as a repo secret — the HS stats path is dormant until it's set. 👤 Mike DeCicco

runbook: No server — Python scripts + GitHub Actions rebuild a static site on GitHub Pages; deploy = push to main
Clone Stadium-Ventures/sv-dugout-pulse, pip install -r requirements.txt (Python 3.11), run `python main.py` locally to test a pulse pass
Secrets are GitHub Actions secrets on the repo — every one is documented (purpose + where to get the value) in docs/SECRETS.md; set with `gh secret set NAME -R Stadium-Ventures/sv-dugout-pulse`
Data stale? Check the dashboard's 'Last updated' stamp → the Actions runs (red = failed, grey = cancelled/timeout) → #sv-automation; diagnostics.html shows which per-school source is failing
Summer assignments change: edit data/summer_ball_placements.json in the repo (Kent's sheet is transcribed by hand, not fetched)

MiLB watch thresholds/copy live in scripts/milb_watch.py — preview any change with `python -m scripts.milb_watch --dry` (prints the Slack post and the status counts, writes nothing, posts nothing); unit tests in tests/test_milb_watch.py
Test the #sv-automation wiring: `gh workflow run cron_health_alert.yml -R Stadium-Ventures/sv-dugout-pulse -f test=true` sends a labeled test post
Bot commits ('Update pulse data [bot]') land every 15 min — always `git pull` before pushing, and never force-push main
